system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Procedural Memoryis embedded in the form of finely tuned system prompts.
system_prompt_style.note: Backend ships prompt classes PlanningPrompt.java / ToolCallPrompt.java; rendering mechanism not shown in provided evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Retrieved documents are parsed using a minimalist browsing tool set restricted to Search, Visit, and Read

context_compaction.evidence_quote: compresses episodic traces into distilled knowledge units via summarization and embedding, ensuring that relevant lessons can be retrieved even when raw histories are prohibitively long
context_compaction.note: SummaryAgent.java present; smolagents truncate_content imported in genie-tool/genie_tool/tool/ci_agent.py.

observation_format.note: Multimodal interpreters return structured outputs but as text to the model.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: all agents operate as CodeAgent, completing tool usage and inter-agent communication through Python code execution
tool_call_format.note: Backend ToolCall/ToolChoice DTOs indicate function-calling path in genie-backend.

tool_count.note: Counted shipped backend tools: CodeInterpreterTool, DeepSearchTool, FileTool, PlanningTool, ReportTool; MCP tools additional and not counted.

edit_primitive.note: No dedicated code-edit primitive; file writing via FileTool/code execution.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a collective multi-agent framework of Plan–Execute and ReAct agents coordinated through critic model voting

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A Supervisor Agent built upon thePlan–Execute framework ensures global coherence of the solution trajectory, while multiple Single Agents based onReAct provide step-level adaptability.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: 子Agent和工具可插拔：预置多种子智能体和工具
delegation_mechanism.note: Sub-agents are exposed as tools (e.g. agent_weather) and invoked by the executor.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: 对于输入的query或者任务，可以直接回答或者解决
human_in_loop.note: No confirmation/approval mechanism appears in the shipped file tree or controller.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Working Memorystores the live execution context, including current plans, intermediate tool outputs, and exchanged messages between agents.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Semantic Memoryrecords the trajectory of completed tasks, including successes, failures, and decision rationales
long_term_memory.note: Paper claims cross-task workflow memory; retrieval is semantic similarity search. Not clearly present in open-sourced code.

state_persistence.note: Only file metadata DB; no resume path found in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We additionally incorporated a Critic model that performs comparative analysis of execution trajectory segments from both systems and provides final answers

retry_policy.evidence_quote: their outputs are aggregated through posterior voting, which can be configured with 3 or 5 models depending on resource availability
retry_policy.note: Parallel ensemble runs rather than sequential retries; closest value.

rollback.evidence_quote: which are executed in isolation, and the execution traces are automatically stored in working memory
rollback.note: No undo/revert facility visible in file tree.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: providing all tools (excluding browser-use tools) and increasing the maximum execution steps
termination_condition.note: TokenLimitExceeded.java exception in backend; final_answer terminates smolagents loop.

execution_isolation.note: Whole product is also shipped as a Docker image (docker run -d -p 3000:3000 ... genie:latest); paper calls it a secure Python sandbox.

filesystem_access.note: Local python executor has host filesystem access within the container boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: The search subsystem employs a multi-source aggregator that queriesGoogle, Bing and DuckDuckGo
network_policy.note: No network restriction configuration found in repository evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Consider passing said import under `additional_authorized_imports` when initializing your CodeAgent.
permission_model.note: Import allowlist in the code executor; no per-call human approval.

tracing.note: SSEPrinter streams structured events to the UI; no OTEL found.

replayability.note: No replay/resume module in the file tree.

eval_hooks.note: GAIA evaluation reported in paper Sec. 4 but no evaluation runner ships in the repo tree.
